numeric_source: frozen exact-int8 export; float checkpoint is not substituted

stages.r1: hidden1 IF rate transport; layer2 receives binary spikes; hidden2 and output activation contract unchanged
stages.r2: add hidden2 IF rate transport; output receives binary spikes; original prototype readout unchanged

if_neuron.input: original uint8 clipped/rounded hidden activation a
if_neuron.spikes: binary, at most one per simulation tick; no multi-valued spike counted as one AC
if_neuron.normalization: signed integer spike-weight accumulation * original per-output scale / T
if_neuron.exact_endpoint: T=255 reproduces each original uint8 activation exactly
if_neuron.state_reset: independent per candidate feature vector and per converted hidden layer

execution.order: layer-serial: finish one layer's rate window before the next; not a pipelined temporal SNN
execution.first_layer: original analog/uint8 input, one dense MAC per connection
execution.output: continuous signed logits and original two-prototype-per-class softmax
execution.timing: T is a coding budget, not milliseconds; original 100 ms closed-window latency remains

backends.spike_add: explicit IF ticks; gather active rows and add original weight rows; no synaptic multiplication in converted connections
backends.count_reference: closed-form spike counts and dense integer matmul; exact reference only, its executed MACs are still counted

cost_scope: Proposal + Refiner neural layers; feature construction/routing/readout and memory traffic not fully counted
stage_progression: Verify ANN replay, then r1 T255 exact alignment, then r2 T255 exact alignment, before comparing low-T points
